referee_caveats_inferred: The preferred spin lies near the upper prior boundary; a wider spin prior and nuisance-model sensitivity tests are needed.
Temporal correlations motivate subsampling, but the supplied text does not give a covariance model or a quantitative full-cadence inference comparison.
The displayed likelihood and error prescription require implementation-level clarification before numerical answer keys can be reproduced.
A three-parameter background fitted to two Stokes values is strongly degenerate; its inferred plasma properties need additional constraints.
The magnetic polarity preferred for the spot conflicts with the background V sign under the shared model assumptions.
The quoted overall plasma and radius ranges are summaries across models, not stated credible intervals.
One synthetic recovery example and a resolution test at a random parameter combination do not establish coverage or numerical accuracy across the entire posterior.
